rows.image_title: File:Rizal Park Front View.jpg
rows.description:
Rizal Park also known as Luneta Park or simply Luneta, is a historical urban park in the Philippines. Located along Roxas Boulevard, Manila, adjacent to the old walled city of Intramuros, it is one of the largest urban parks in Asia. It has been a favorite leisure spot, and is frequented on Sundays and national holidays. Rizal Park is one of the major tourist attractions of Manila. Depicted is the Rizal Monument with the Torre de Manila in the background.
